---
title: "Blog"
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  # 🤖 list, not grid: most posts have no image, and a grid filled them
  # with placeholders. No image-placeholder here, so a post without an
  # image is text-only (theme.scss hides Quarto's empty thumbnail box)
  type: default
  image-align: right
  categories: true
  # partial = excerpt + link in RSS; full content ballooned blog.xml to 51MB
  # because the cherry-blossom post embeds ~51MB of mapgl widget JSON
  feed:
    type: partial
  fields: [image, date, title, description, categories, reading-time]
page-layout: full
toc: false
---
